activities.activity_name: Implement Ambari support for Spring XD on YARN
activities.activity_description: Develop integration to allow Spring XD to be deployed and managed via Apache Ambari on YARN, including configuration and cluster setup.

activities.activity_name: Integrate spring-cloud-config server with spring-bus modules
activities.activity_description: Add dependency and configuration to use spring-cloud-config server for centralized property management in spring-bus modules.

activities.activity_name: Investigate and fix channel performance issues in Spring Integration 4.2
activities.activity_description: Profile channel performance, identify bottlenecks, implement corrective actions (e.g., thread pool tuning, message batching), and verify improvements.

activities.activity_name: Measure baseline serialization characteristics in Spring XD
activities.activity_description: Design and execute benchmarks to measure serialization performance, document results, and identify areas for improvement.

activities.activity_name: Review spring-bus architecture and design specifications
activities.activity_description: Review current architecture and design docs, identify foundational gaps, and produce a report with recommendations.

activities.activity_name: Upgrade Spring XD version in Ambari plugin from 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA
activities.activity_description: Update plugin dependencies, adjust configuration, test upgrade path, and provide documentation for the upgrade.

activities.activity_name: Add support for fsUri=file:// to use Hadoop LocalFileSystem
activities.activity_description: Modify resource resolution logic to handle file:// URI, ensuring it works for single-node setups and documenting multi-node limitations.

activities.activity_name: Implement system properties pass-through for Sqoop job
activities.activity_description: Add configuration option to allow user-specified system properties (e.g., memory settings) to be passed to the Sqoop Java process.

activities.activity_name: Perform integration and system testing across all user stories
activities.activity_description: Develop and execute comprehensive test cases to verify end-to-end functionality, including cross-component interactions.

activities.activity_name: Write user documentation and release notes
activities.activity_description: Update documentation for each user story, including configuration guides, upgrade instructions, and known limitations.

activities.activity_name: Code review, refactoring, and merge preparation
activities.activity_description: Conduct peer reviews, address feedback, perform necessary refactoring, and prepare the final code for merging into the main branch.
